CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real Phase 1c shipped server-side: falling fragments now spin at a real, deterministic constant rate (rotation_deg on PcFallingFragment, 90-270 deg/s derived from fragment_idx), verified live via a real UDP probe matching the hand-computed expected rate (167.1429 vs observed 167.1428 deg/s, ratio 1.000); wire cost measured at 1432 bytes, still 40 under budget; client rendering deliberately deferred (no live Xvfb verification available), matching Phase 1a/1b's own honest scope pattern (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
